sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
Today we travel to South America.
We go to the country of Peru.
Peru is a country in South America.
South America is far from Europe.
Many old cultures lived in Peru.
Arquipa is one important city in Peru.
It is not the capital, but it is very special.
Arquipa is in the south of Peru.
It is not near the ocean.
It is far from the sea.
The city is near the Andes Mountains.
The city is above sea level.
The weather in Arquipa is very nice.
It does not rain a lot.
During the day, it is warm.
Volcanoes are mountains with fire inside.
The most famous volcano is Misty.
You can see Misty from the city.
It is part of their life.
Arquipa is called the white city.
They are made from white stone.
When the sun shines, the city looks white.
The city looks calm and peaceful.
The old city is very beautiful.
The heart of Arquipa is Plaza de Armas.
Next to the square is a big cathedral.
It is white and very large.
It looks like a small city.
The walls are red and blue.
A famous dish is Rocoto Roleno.
Arquipa is a city of stone, sun, history, and calm life.
This was the Slow English Podcast.
